scope: offline-only strict-OOF Router Recall@50 rescue and Router/P8U blend ablation; uses immutable original outer-fold P8U probe models because the raw prior-label ledger is temporarily unavailable; no canonical, admission, portfolio, execution, or live change

p8u.training_population: not refit in this variant: immutable outer-fold source-bundle probe models were already trained prequentially on strictly prior resolved rows
p8u.geometry: reuse each outer fold's immutable source NMF geometry and the probe_models embedded in that same bundle; no refit, alignment, HPO, or feature selection
p8u.score_normalization: within-timestamp deterministic percentile rank, computed target-free independently for Router and P8U before blending

outcome_sidecar.contract: existing sealed held outcomes only; loaded and joined after target-free source-bundle scoring, never used for scoring or selection

controls.selection: no arm is promoted or selected on held results; pooled and per-quarter metrics are reported for falsification only
